name: Crime Patrol Dial 100
description: Fictional representation of real life crime cases in India. The host dissects some of the most gruesome crimes encountered by police forces across India while re-enactments display the situations faced by the victims.

videos.title: Mautana
videos.overview: A village woman goes to the police station and says her son's dead body has been hanging from a tree for the last 18 months. But what happened to her son?

videos.title: Goli Number- 10
videos.overview: A watchman named Ramakant's daughter, Asha goes missing from her school. Police suspect an NGO worker named Mansi as she was the last person to see Asha.

videos.title: Dushkarm
videos.overview: A woman's sister named Vinita, who is mentally unstable, goes missing. Later, the police find out a girl's dead body and learn that she had been gang-raped. Is this Vinita or someone else?

videos.title: Pratha
videos.overview: People sell the women in their families for money in a place called Mahanagar. Later, a woman jumps from a building in Mumbai along with her infant daughter. Did she commit suicide or someone murdered her?

videos.overview: Some assailants travelling in an auto, viciously murder a young girl in broad daylight, by dragging her across the street. No one witnessing this crime comes to the aid of the girl. Who would be heartless enough to commit such a barbaric act?

videos.overview: Shikha breaks the aquarium in her school and gets reprimanded for it. Her mischievous behaviour annoys everyone. Then one day, Shikha goes missing.

videos.title: The Mysterious Death
videos.overview: Pratima admits her husband, Harish, to the hospital. Harish is severely injured and the doctor believes that he was involved in a fight. The police is called in and they inquire about Harish with Pratima.

videos.title: Wanted - Part 1
videos.overview: In this two part episode, four women: Kusum, Sunita, Neelam and Gurbansh are wanted by the police. The case begins when Gurbansh's daughter-in-law, Pooja, is found brutally murdered in Dr. Vikram's house.

videos.title: Wanted - Part 2
videos.overview: In the previous episode, Kusum, Sunita, Neelam and Gurbansh are wanted by the police. The case begins when Gurbansh's daughter-in-law, Pooja, is found brutally murdered in Dr. Vikram's house. In this episode, the police go through the call records of Sunita and suspect that she might have some connection with Ashutosh Tyagi. The police are now searching for Gurbansh and Neelam, who are on the run.

videos.title: Kandivali Murder Case
videos.overview: Manisha is found brutally murdered in her house. Anand, her husband, is left in a state of shock. The police begin investigation into the murder case.

videos.title: Bhayandar Murder Case
videos.overview: Sushanth learns that his father has died in an accident. The police begin investigation into the accident, which appears to be planned murder. Sushanth is fitness trainer at a gym owned by Amrita. Sushanth used to train Ujjwala, which his father did not like. He had forced Sushanth to quit his job but the latter insisted on continuing it.

videos.title: Vasai Triple Murder Case
videos.overview: Two fishermen find a metal trunk entangled in their fishing net. When they open it up, they find the body of a small girl inside it. The forensic report reveals that the kid, who was aged between 4-5, was strangled before being thrown in the trunk.

videos.title: Dahisar Double Murder Case
videos.overview: Two close friends, Rohan and Sachin, leave their home in order to attend their tuition class. However, they meet at a fort and wait for a few strangers. Rohan is confident that this will change their lives. However, a few hours later, dead bodies of Rohan and Sachin are discovered from the place.

videos.title: Belgaum
videos.overview: In Karnataka, a mother, who had tried to save her daughter from some rituals, is tied up by the villagers. Thousand of miles away, her daughter was battling in a hospital.

videos.title: Gopalganj Murder Case
videos.overview: Kanak arrives at the police station to lodge a complaint against her own mother for forcing her into abortion of the child she was carrying. However, when the police goes to arrest her mother Abha and her friend Jyoti (who was an accomplice in the act) both of them go missing.

videos.title: The Deathly Tunnel - Part 1
videos.overview: Two girls, Neeti and Komal, are travelling along with Meena and Jayant. Sharad, their father, calls up Meena to inquire about his daughters. The night turns out to be a nightmare for Sharad as the car in which Neeti and Komal are travelling in never makes it out of a tunnel. Sharad leaves no stone unturned to find his beloved daughters. After ten years the case takes a turn. Will Sharad meet his daughters? What nearly occurred that ill-fated night inside the tunnel?

videos.title: The Deathly Tunnel - Part 2
videos.overview: In the previous episode, two girls, Neeti and Komal, were travelling along with Meena and Jayant. The night turned out to be a nightmare for Sharad, their father, as the car in which Neeti and Komal were travelling in never made it out of a tunnel. Sharad left no stone unturned to find his beloved daughters. After ten years, Sharad's wait was finally over. In this episode, the police inquire Raghu, who is suspected of murdering his mother.

videos.title: Kandivali Kidnapping Case
videos.overview: The case begins after Ayushi goes missing. During the investigation, the police discover that Ayushi was being beaten by her father.

videos.title: Pune Murder Case
videos.overview: Avinash, a housing society secretary, decides not to give houses on rent for bachelors. The announcement comes as a shock for Renu and Preeti, who live in the society.

videos.title: Ghatkopar Murder Case
videos.overview: Peter, Roshni's neighbor, enters her house and finds a boy, who is badly injured. Then, Roshni leaves her house in a hurry with the boy. Meanwhile, police find a dead body of a woman.

videos.title: Jogeshwari Kidnapping Case
videos.overview: A man finds the dead body of an elderly woman and informs the police about it. The postmortem reveals that the woman underwent a heart surgery and had pacemaker placed in the chest. Using this information, the police decide to determine the identity of the woman. Meanwhile, at an isolated spot, a man is holding a youth in confinement. During the investigation, it is learnt that the woman, Radhika, owned a jewellery shop. Radhika had refused to get her daughter married to Kunti's son.

videos.title: Muzaffarpur Murder Case
videos.overview: A woman arrives at the engagement ceremony of her sister with the police, and her sister's proposed groom is arrested for demanding dowry. However, her family looks down on her for doing so. A few days later, the woman's dead body is found in the jungle.

videos.title: The Missing Child And Wife
videos.overview: A man is travelling with his wife and his kid through the Delhi-Agra highway in Uttar Pradesh. All of a sudden, their car comes to a halt due to a puncture. They stop in front of a dhaba and the wife goes to the washroom with the kid as the man fixes the tyre. His wife does not return after a long while, and the man searches for her frantically. He tries to call her but finds that her phone is in the field beside the dhaba.

videos.title: Malad Murder Case - Part 1
videos.overview: A 6-year-old girl, who is an orphan and is abused by her adopted family, finds herself in the center of the murder of two of her friends. Later, the girl disappears as well, and the police find out that the person hiding her has also been murdered.

videos.title: Malad Murder Case - Part 2
videos.overview: A 6-year-old girl, who is an orphan and is abused by her adopted family, finds herself in the center of the murder of two of her friends. Later, the girl disappears as well, and the police find out that the person who was hiding her has also been murdered.

videos.title: Three Suicides
videos.overview: nAccording to statistics, 24 suicides take place in India every day and 12-14 suicides are conducted by people aged below 18. It also claims that most of these victims are aged between 8 to 12.

videos.title: Panvel Double Murder Case
videos.overview: Even in this day and age, love marriage still remains a taboo in a lot of the families. This episode of the Crime Patrol shows how a marriage proposal destroyed Sonakshi and her family.

videos.title: Malvani Double Murder Case
videos.overview: A 10-year-old kid is chased by a couple of goons. Trying to save his life, the kid tries to cross the road but meets with an accident with a car and dies on the way to the hospital.

videos.title: Lucknow Double Murder Case
videos.overview: Bashir is weak in studies and has failed to clear his board exams in his previous two attempts. However, this time he is determined to clear the hurdle. On the day of his result, Bashir disappears. A few days later, his dead body is found.

videos.title: Mumbai
videos.overview: Anita, a struggling actress, is desperately looking for a role in a movie. She needs money in order to sustain herself and her sister, Charu. Their landlady, Anuradha gives them an ultimatum.

videos.title: Mumbai-Nagpur Triple Murder - Part 2
videos.overview: Anita, a struggling actress, is desperately looking for a role in a movie. She needs money in order to sustain herself and her sister Charu. Their landlord Anuradha gives them an ultimatum.

videos.title: Bandra - Part 1
videos.overview: In the middle of the night, a van rams into a wall killing the driver and critically injuring the cleaner. Meanwhile, four kids sneak out of the van's compartment and runs away. The next day, the police investigates the accident scene, where they find the dead body of a kid inside the van's compartment. The police officers are baffled when they discover bruises on the child's dead body. In the meantime, they decide to interrogate Shivam, the van's cleaner who is recovering in the hospital.

videos.title: Bandra-Kalina Murders - Part 2
videos.overview: The police learn that the van which met with the accident belongs to Prashant More from Kalina. The officers soon reach Prashant's house where Prashant's wife informs them that her husband is a medical representative. The police tells her that Prashant is a wanted suspect along with a woman named Sharda for kidnapping five children. Meanwhile, the four children are shocked when they see posters with their photos all over the city.

videos.title: A Victim Of Circumstances
videos.overview: An infant, who was poisoned in a temple, is brought to a hospital. A mysterious woman watches all the happenings from a distance, as the police try to figure out the person behind it. The woman then boards a bus to Nagpur from Mumbai and upon her arrival, she tries to flee with another kid before being caught.

videos.title: Mumbai Kolhapur Double Murder
videos.overview: A woman files a missing report for her daughter, Naina , who had been missing for the past three years. Meanwhile, the police excavate a dead body in a sack and find that it is burnt beyond recognition. However, they find an identity card at the crime scene. On further investigation they find that the card belongs to a woman, Mehak , who was missing. The case takes an interesting turn when the police learn that Naina and Mehak is the same person.

videos.title: Hingoli Double Murder
videos.overview: Vijay, who is a 10-year-old kid, and his younger brother Sarvesh leave from their home late in the night with a bag in their hand. Early in the morning, Sarvesh tells Vijay that he is tired and needs to rest.

videos.title: Nagpur Triple Murder
videos.overview: Ankush arrives at the police station and lodges a complaint that his friend, Dhruv is missing for two days and that his parents are not giving him any information about his whereabouts. When the police reach Dhruv's house to investigate, Dhruv's father tells them that their son has gone to a meditation center where calls are not allowed. Ankush, however, refuses to believe this and tells the police that they should search for Dhruv. Soon after leaving the police station, Ankush is murdered by a stranger.

videos.title: Ratnagairi Murder Maharashtra - Part 1
videos.overview: A young boy is kidnapped, and at the same time a woman's corpse is found in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra. The police suspect that Eknath Shinde, an influential construction magnate, is linked to the kidnapping and the murder.

videos.title: Ratnagiri Murder Maharashtra - Part 2
videos.overview: A young boy is kidnapped, and at the same time a woman's corpse is found in Ratnagiri, Maharashtra. The police suspect that Eknath Shinde, an influential construction magnate, is linked to the kidnapping and the murder.

videos.title: Abduction
videos.overview: A 15-year-old girl, Nidhi, is missing. Her mother rushes to the police station to file a complaint. The police understanding the mother's predicament, take swift action and begin investigation after registering a complaint. The police discover that Akash, who married Nidhi's mother, might be involved. Where is Nidhi and who has kidnapped her?

videos.title: Abduction Part 2
videos.overview: In this continuation episode, the police find the missing girl, Nidhi, collapsed on the road and rush her to the hospital where she reunites with her mother. Meanwhile, the police find a dead body and the mother of one of the suspects is called to identify. She identifies it as her son, Sanju. However, the police later receive a call from Sanju who surrenders himself. Is Sanju alive? Who was involved in Nidhi's kidnapping?

videos.title: A Brothers Murder
videos.overview: Aman, the brother of a hearing and speech impaired girl, Pihu, is murdered. A note left at the crime scene claims that Aman raped a woman. But, Aman, as claimed by Pihu and his friends, could not have committed such a crime. Later, two more murders, that of Prabha and Dina, make the case more complicated.

videos.title: The Cost of Unemployment
videos.overview: Asma is found murdered by the police. The investigation of the murder reveals that Asma had issues with her employer, Indu, and was fired. The police reach the doorstep of Asma's employer to interrogate. The police suspect that Indu is trying to hide something.

videos.title: Mumbai Dreams
videos.overview: Romi is an aspiring model, who wants to make it big in the modelling world at any cost. Rohan is her brother, whose wants are fulfilled by his parents. Romi threatens to commit suicide if her parents do not support her dreams.

videos.title: Invisible Man
videos.overview: Pari, a nine-year-old girl, is terrified of a stranger, who she claims is threatening her. Pari's mother blames her mother-in-law for telling horror stories to her daughter. The police are called in to investigate.

videos.title: Shortcut to Death
videos.overview: Shiela returns home with her son, Rohan, and finds that her husband, Rahul, has hanged himself. The police begin investigation of this suicide case and learn that Rahul was repeatedly calling a number.

videos.title: Kolhapur Rape And Double Murder Case
videos.overview: A gravely injured Dimple is battling for her life in the hospital when the police approaches her. Dimple tells the police that her cousin sister, Suhali pushed her onto a rushing car with the intention of killing her.

videos.title: Murder By Mistake
videos.overview: Savita meets with Ashok and his family as their marriage is getting arranged. But, Savita is smitten by Baldev, Ashok's brother. Ashok begins to like Savita and calls her relentlessly in order to persuade her to marry him.

videos.title: The Mysterious Disappearance
videos.overview: Naina goes into labor and as she is in severe pain, her sister-in-law, instead of taking her to the hospital asks a mid-wife, Janki, to help out. As a result, Naina delivers two children at home. But, one of the new borns does not survive.

videos.title: Death of Humanity - Part 1
videos.overview: Preeti and Shilpi are the victims of acid attack. The police begin investigation after a third girl, Bulbul goes missing. The police while investigating learn that Rehmath, who works for Kedar Singh, might be involved and arrest him.

videos.title: Death of Humanity - Part 2
videos.overview: In the previous episode the police were investigating the mysterious disappearance of a girl named Bulbul. In this episode, the police are parallely investigating the murder of Laiba, whose death is related to Bulbul's case.

videos.title: The Kidnapped Girl - Part 1
videos.overview: Neeta arrives at the police station to register a missing complaint of her daughter. Aashi is missing. The police begin investigation into the case and soon discover that Aashi has been abducted. The police soon learn that Salma and Tahir had kidnapped Aashi. But, the investigation meets a dead end when the police learn that Tahir is dead. Will the police be able to bring the culprits to justice?

videos.title: The Kidnapped Girl - Part 2
videos.overview: In the previous episode, the police were investigating the kidnapping of Aashi. The prime suspect in the case, Tahir, is dead and the police are now looking to catch Salma, who holds all the keys to the case. The police comes to know that Mahendra conspired with Salma to kidnap Aashi.

videos.title: Dysfunctional Family
videos.overview: A fight breaks out between cousin brothers, Chirag and Gaurav, over the identity of Chirags father. Bhavin is insulted by his family members for trying to protect Chirag. Then, Chirag and Gaurav both disappear mysteriously. Bhavin and his family members approach the police to find the missing children.

videos.title: Manipulative Mind
videos.overview: Manav returns to his in-laws house and pleads with his wife, Kavya, to forgive him. But, Kavya refuses to erase the bitter memories of the past. Manav is accused of having an affair and is forced to end all ties with his wife.

videos.title: Death By Dowry
videos.overview: Ritu, a newly married woman, receives a phonecall from a stranger and is asked to come to an isolated location. She is forced to lie to her mother-in-law and leaves. But when she mysteriously disappears, her family, including her husband is worried.

videos.title: The Silent Victim - Part 1
videos.overview: Jhumri finds herself in the police station, after the residents of a housing society file a complaint with the police against her. The police are informed that Jhumri walked into Mohit's house and informed Mohit that she is pregnant with his child. Then, one day, Jhumri goes missing.

videos.title: The Silent Victim - Part 2
videos.overview: In the previous episode, the police were investigating the kidnapping of Jhumri. After Jhumri is discovered severely injured, the police begin to dig deep into the mysteries surrounding the case. In this episode the police interrogate Mohit, as Jhumri claims that he is the father of her unborn child. Later, women rights activists attack Mohit but his family stand by his side.

videos.title: Death of Dreams
videos.overview: In Panvel, Navi Mumbai, deep in the woods, the police find a woman's dead body in a gunny bag. The police begin the investigation into the murder case of the woman who was trying hard to make ends meet and provide for her son, Dhruv.

videos.title: A Wifes Ordeal
videos.overview: Vasudha, while trying to save her daughter, Neelam, was disfigured in a fire accident. Ever since then, her husband, Mangesh, has disregarded her. Judged by her appearance, Vasudha finds herself isolated from her family, including her daughter. One day, Mangesh mysteriously disappears.

videos.title: A Murder In Kolkata Part 1
videos.overview: Gautam pulls out a gun and shoots Tulika at point blank range. After shooting her dead, Gautam tries to escape. Tulika was a budding political leader. Several hundred kilometres away, Gautam's mother kills her husband.

videos.title: A Murder In Kolkata Part 2
videos.overview: Why did a 12-year-old Gautam murder Tulika? This second part of 'A Murder In Kolkata' will give answers to the questions left unanswered in yesterday's episode of Crime Patrol Dial 100. In this episode, Gautam is arrested by the police. He pleads to the police to help him save his mother, whose life is in danger.
